instruction: Run `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\sallen_key.cir` in native PSpice. Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\sallen_key.out`, `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\sallen_key_measure.txt`, and `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\sallen_key.dat`. Then read the nine corner measurement blocks from `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\sallen_key_measure.txt` and write `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\wc.json` with `BW_nominal`, `BW_min`, `BW_max`, `corner_min`, and `corner_max`, where each `BW_*` value is the highest sampled frequency that remains within 3 dB of that corner's peak sample.
source: PSpice native nonideal stepped-corner sample-grid cutoff analysis for a Sallen-Key filter
